projects_row_level.name: projects_row_level
projects_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  trim(both ' ' from nullif(p.title, '')) AS title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution,
  nullif(p.framework_program, '') AS framework_program,
  nullif(p.acronym, '') AS acronym,
  nullif(p.ec_ref, '') AS ec_ref,
  nullif(p.cordis_ref, '') AS cordis_ref
FROM projects p
projects_row_level.description: Canonical, cleaned project rows exposing project identifiers, title, dates, financial measures and key foreign keys. Useful as a reusable base for filtering projects by title, id, year, or funding attributes and for computing aggregates later.

project_members_by_project.name: project_members_by_project
project_members_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.member_short_name AS member_short_name,
  pm.geocode_regions_3 AS organization_geocode_regions_3
FROM
  project_members pm
project_members_by_project.description: Denormalized rows of project members joined to their project id and basic member attributes. One row per project-member association; useful for queries that filter or aggregate by project and examine member-level contributions, institutions, countries, or roles.

institutions_core.name: institutions_core

SELECT

institutions_core.description: Canonical institution rows exposing id, name, country reference and geo identifiers for reuse when joining project members or filtering by institution/country/region.

project_financials_by_project.name: project_financials_by_project
project_financials_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution
FROM projects_row_level p
project_financials_by_project.description: Project-level financial measures (keeps one row per project) — exposes raw monetary fields for aggregations or rollups. This view is grouped at project unics_id so downstream queries can sum/avg across cohorts without re-aggregating at the wrong grain.

projects_core.name: projects_core
projects_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.ec_call,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program,
  -- prefer aggregated financials view if present, otherwise fall back to projects table
  COALESCE(f.total_cost, p.total_cost) AS total_cost,
  COALESCE(f.ec_max_contribution, p.ec_max_contribution) AS ec_max_contribution,
  p.principal_investigator
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_project f
  ON f.unics_id = p.unics_id
projects_core.description: Canonical normalized projection of the projects table exposing key identifiers, timing, costs, and funding/program fields for per-project analyses.

project_time_window.name: project_time_window
project_time_window.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  -- lift any filter/constant literals out of the view (none required here)
  COALESCE(p.start_year, EXTRACT(year FROM p.start_date)::integer) AS start_year,
  COALESCE(p.end_year, EXTRACT(year FROM p.end_date)::integer) AS end_year
FROM projects_row_level p
project_time_window.description: A focused cohort view emphasizing project temporal attributes (start/end dates and derived years) to support year-based filters and temporal range queries.

project_parties.name: project_parties
project_parties.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id                                                   AS project_unics_id,
  p.acronym                                                     AS acronym,
  p.principal_investigator                                      AS principal_investigator,
  pi.full_name                                                  AS pi_full_name,
  pm.unics_id                                                   AS member_unics_id,
  pm.member_name                                                AS member_name,
  pm.institution_id                                             AS institution_id,
  inst.institutions_name                                        AS institutions_name,
  pm.country                                                    AS country,
  pm.ec_contribution                                            AS ec_contribution
FROM
  projects_core p
LEFT JOIN
  people pi
ON
  p.principal_investigator IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.unics_id = p.principal_investigator
LEFT JOIN
  project_members_by_project pm
ON
  pm.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN
  institutions_core inst
ON
  pm.institution_id IS NOT NULL
  AND inst.unics_id = pm.institution_id
project_parties.description: Denormalized view linking projects to principal investigator (person) and institution(s) via principal_investigator and project_members/institutions, exposing basic party attributes for each project.

projects_core_27.name: projects_core_27
projects_core_27.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  -- canonical short acronym: prefer projects_row_level.acronym, else projects.acronym
  COALESCE(prl.acronym, p.acronym) AS acronym,
  -- canonical title: prefer projects_row_level.title, else projects.title
  COALESCE(prl.title, p.title) AS title,
  -- canonical start/end dates and years (lifted from the time-window / row-level views if present)
  COALESCE(ptw.start_date, prl.start_date, p.start_date) AS start_date,
  COALESCE(ptw.end_date, prl.end_date, p.end_date) AS end_date,
  COALESCE(ptw.start_year, prl.start_year, p.start_year) AS start_year,
  COALESCE(ptw.end_year, prl.end_year, p.end_year) AS end_year,
  -- funding/program frame: prefer normalized row-level value then raw projects
  COALESCE(prl.framework_program, p.framework_program) AS framework_program,
  COALESCE(prl.ec_ref, p.ec_ref) AS ec_ref,
  COALESCE(prl.cordis_ref, p.cordis_ref) AS cordis_ref,
  -- funding scheme / call from projects table
  p.ec_call,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  -- financials: prefer aggregated financials view, else project row
  COALESCE(pfbp.total_cost, prl.total_cost, p.total_cost) AS total_cost,
  COALESCE(pfbp.ec_max_contribution, prl.ec_max_contribution, p.ec_max_contribution) AS ec_max_contribution,
  -- principal investigator id (raw from projects)
  p.principal_investigator,
  -- lead institution: derive the institution_id with highest ec_contribution from project members if present
  lead.member_institution_id AS lead_institution_id,
  lead.member_name AS lead_member_name,
  lead.member_short_name AS lead_member_short_name,
  lead.member_country AS lead_member_country,
  -- canonical lead institution details if institution lookup available
  inst.unics_id AS institution_unics_id,
  inst.institutions_name AS institution_name,
  inst.country_id AS institution_country_id,
  inst.geocode_regions_3 AS institution_geocode_regions_3,
  inst.acronym AS institution_acronym,
  inst.short_name AS institution_short_name,
  inst.website AS institution_website,
  inst.grid_id AS institution_grid_id
FROM projects p
-- attempt to join to the normalized row-level view to prefer its cleaned values
LEFT JOIN projects_row_level prl ON prl.unics_id = p.unics_id
-- time-window canonicalization helper view (may refine dates/years)
LEFT JOIN project_time_window ptw ON ptw.unics_id = p.unics_id
-- aggregated financials (preferred)
LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_project pfbp ON pfbp.unics_id = p.unics_id
-- determine lead member (highest ec_contribution) via the project_members_by_project view
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    m.institution_id AS member_institution_id,
    m.member_name,
    m.member_short_name,
    m.country AS member_country
  FROM project_members_by_project m
  WHERE m.project = p.unics_id
  ORDER BY m.ec_contribution DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
) AS lead ON true
-- bring institution core details if available
LEFT JOIN institutions_core inst ON inst.unics_id = lead.member_institution_id
projects_core_27.description: Canonical project rows with key identifiers and commonly used project attributes normalized/cleaned for reuse (one row per project).

topics_canonical.name: topics_canonical
topics_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical topic code: trim whitespace and force to lower-case for normalization,
  -- but keep original case if stored codes should be preserved elsewhere; here we produce a normalized canonical key
  lower(trim(coalesce(code, ''))) AS code,
  -- rcn as provided (lifted literal handling: none needed here)
  coalesce(rcn, '') AS rcn,
  -- human-readable title: prefer title from topics table, fall back to rcn or empty string
  coalesce(nullif(trim(title), ''), nullif(trim(coalesce(rcn, '')), ''), '') AS title
FROM topics
topics_canonical.description: Canonical topic metadata: one row per topic code with title and rcn. Normalizes/cleans topic identifiers and exposes the human-readable title used in answers.

project_members_cohort.name: project_members_cohort
project_members_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT

  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution
FROM project_members pm
project_members_cohort.description: Row-level cohort of project_members exposing membership attributes and linking to project id. One row per project_member (as stored in project_members). Useful for filtering projects by member attributes (country, institution, role, contribution, location).

project_member_institutions.name: project_member_institutions
project_member_institutions.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.country AS "project_members.country",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  i.unics_id AS "institutions.unics_id AS institution_unics_id",
  i.country_id AS "institutions.country_id",
  i.institutions_name AS "institutions.institutions_name",
  i.acronym AS "institutions.acronym AS institution_acronym",
  i.geocode_regions_3 AS "institutions.geocode_regions_3"
FROM project_members pm
LEFT JOIN institutions i
  ON pm.institution_id = i.unics_id
project_member_institutions.description: Denormalized view joining project_members to institutions to expose member's institution and its country/region information. One row per project_member (project_members.unics_id). Helpful when questions need geographic or institution-level filters for project participants.

institutions_by_country_id.name: institutions_by_country_id
institutions_by_country_id.body_sql:
SELECT
  ic.institutions_name
FROM
  institutions_core ic
LEFT JOIN
  countries c
ON
  ic.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_by_country_id.description: Denormalized list of institutions with their linked country information (one row per institution). Useful for filtering institutions by country name or country codes and for joining institution attributes with country attributes.

institutions_core_37.name: institutions_core_37
institutions_core_37.description: Canonical projection of institutions exposing core identifying and geo columns. Normalizes available identifiers and preserves raw geographic keys for later joins/filters.

countries_core.name: countries_core
countries_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.unics_id,
  c.country_name,
  c.country_code2,
  c.country_code3,
  c.geocode_country_code
FROM countries c
countries_core.description: Canonical projection of countries with primary keys and commonly used name/code fields for joining and filtering.
validated_on: Show me the country name of all institutes.
What is the country code 2 and country code 3 for Andorra?
counter_examples: Show me the country of all institutes.

institutions_with_country.name: institutions_with_country
institutions_with_country.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id AS unics_id,
  i.institutions_name AS institutions_name,
  i.country_id AS country_id,
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  i.acronym AS acronym,
  i.short_name AS short_name,
  i.website AS website,
  i.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_with_country.description: Denormalized view joining institutions to countries (when country_id is present) to expose institution rows with country_name for filtering and display. Includes institutions with NULL country_id (country_name will be NULL).

projects_with_program_and_funding_scheme.name: projects_with_program_and_funding_scheme
projects_with_program_and_funding_scheme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.framework_program,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  fp.ec_framework_program_name AS programme_title,
  fs.title AS funding_scheme_title
FROM projects_core p
LEFT JOIN ec_framework_programs fp
  ON p.framework_program = fp.ec_framework_program_name
LEFT JOIN funding_schemes fs
  ON p.ec_fund_scheme = fs.code
projects_with_program_and_funding_scheme.description: Denormalized view joining projects to programme and funding scheme descriptive dimensions (framework program title and funding scheme title) to support filtering and grouping by program/scheme.

project_start_date_cohort.name: project_start_date_cohort
project_start_date_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  -- normalize start_date: prefer projects_row_level.start_date, fall back to projects.start_date, else null
  COALESCE(prl.start_date, p.start_date) AS start_date,
  -- extract start_year from the chosen start_date; if start_year already available in projects_row_level use it
  COALESCE(prl.start_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(prl.start_date, p.start_date))::integer, p.start_year) AS start_year
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_row_level prl USING (unics_id)
project_start_date_cohort.description: Row-level cohort view exposing project ids with normalized start_date and extracted start_year to support year-based filtering and aggregation.

projects_costs_by_project.name: projects_costs_by_project
projects_costs_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pr.unics_id,
  pr.title,
  -- lift literal for NULL replacement out of view: use NULL as default if missing
  -- ensure numeric casting for total_cost so downstream ranking works reliably
  CASE
    WHEN pf.total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN pf.total_cost::double precision
    WHEN pr.total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN pr.total_cost::double precision
    ELSE NULL
  END AS total_cost
FROM projects_row_level pr
LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_project pf
  ON pf.unics_id = pr.unics_id
projects_costs_by_project.description: Per-project cost measures (no further aggregation) prepared for ranking and comparisons — duplicates the project key and raw numeric cost fields, ensuring numeric casting if needed.

project_members_raw.name: project_members_raw
project_members_raw.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.project AS project,
  COALESCE(pm.institution_id, pbp.institution_id) AS institution_id,
  COALESCE(pm.member_role, pbp.member_role) AS member_role,
  COALESCE(pm.country, pbp.country) AS country,
  COALESCE(pm.ec_contribution, pbp.ec_contribution) AS ec_contribution,
  COALESCE(pm.member_name, pbp.member_name) AS member_name,
  COALESCE(pm.geocode_regions_3, inst.geocode_regions_3, pbp.organization_geocode_regions_3) AS geocode_regions_3
FROM project_members pm
LEFT JOIN project_members_by_project pbp
  ON pm.unics_id = pbp.unics_id
LEFT JOIN institutions_core inst
  ON COALESCE(pm.institution_id, pbp.institution_id) = inst.unics_id
project_members_raw.description: Row-level canonicalized project member records. One row per project_members.unics_id (member record). Exposes raw member identifiers, project link, institution, role, location and contribution fields for downstream filtering and aggregation.

project_member_counts.name: project_member_counts
project_member_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pm.unics_id) AS member_count,
  SUM(pm.ec_contribution) AS member_ec_contribution_total
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_members pm
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
GROUP BY p.unics_id
project_member_counts.description: Aggregate counts of distinct members per project. One row per project (projects.unics_id) with the raw distinct member count and optional raw member contribution sum. Useful for thresholding projects by membership size or reporting membership magnitude.

projects_row_level_45.name: projects_row_level_45
projects_row_level_45.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date
FROM projects p
WHERE (p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL)
projects_row_level_45.description: One row per project exposing project identifiers and funding scheme for cohort, filtering out rows with NULL funding scheme when needed.

funding_schemes_dims.name: funding_schemes_dims
funding_schemes_dims.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code,
  fs.title
FROM funding_schemes fs
funding_schemes_dims.description: Canonical projection of funding scheme codes and titles (one row per funding scheme).
validated_on: Find the code of the funding scheme for Framework Partnership Agreement

projects_count_by_funding_scheme.name: projects_count_by_funding_scheme
projects_count_by_funding_scheme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
  COUNT(*)::bigint AS project_count
FROM
  projects p
GROUP BY
  p.ec_fund_scheme
projects_count_by_funding_scheme.description: Counts of projects per funding scheme code. One row per funding scheme code with raw project_count measure.

project_members_minimal.name: project_members_minimal
project_members_minimal.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.country,
  pm.member_role,
  pm.ec_contribution,
  pm.geocode_regions_3
FROM project_members pm
project_members_minimal.description: One-row-per-project-member from project_members exposing project id, member institution id, member name, country, role and financial contribution. Useful for questions that filter or aggregate by participating organisations or contributions.
counter_examples: Show the project title and member name where the member has a partner role

projects_with_programme_and_topics.name: projects_with_programme_and_topics
projects_with_programme_and_topics.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  pp.programme AS programme,
  psa.subject_area AS subject_area,
  pt.topic AS topic
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_subject_areas psa
  ON psa.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_topics pt
  ON pt.project = p.unics_id
projects_with_programme_and_topics.description: Denormalized view linking projects to their programmes, subject areas and topics. One row per project-programme-subjectarea-topic combination to support filtering and faceting by programme/subject/topic.

projects_rowlevel_years.name: projects_rowlevel_years
projects_rowlevel_years.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  -- lift literals: none needed here; keep year integers as-is from source
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  -- raw computed duration: end_year - start_year (can be NULL if either is NULL)
  (p.end_year - p.start_year) AS duration_years
FROM projects_row_level p
projects_rowlevel_years.description: Normalized row-level project records exposing project id, basic metadata and start/end years as integers and a raw computed duration (end_year - start_year). Keeps one row per project allowing downstream filters/aggregations.

projects_core_metadata.name: projects_core_metadata
projects_core_metadata.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year
FROM projects_row_level p
projects_core_metadata.description: Selectable cohort of project basic metadata (id, acronym, title, start/end years and key funding/program columns) without computed measures. Useful for filtering projects by presence of years or joining to other entities while preserving raw columns.

projects_with_principal_investigator_and.name: projects_with_principal_investigator_and_institution
projects_with_principal_investigator_and.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS "people.full_name",
  p.framework_program AS "projects.framework_program",
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS "projects.ec_fund_scheme"
FROM
  projects_core p
LEFT JOIN
  people pe
ON
  p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
projects_with_principal_investigator_and.description: Denormalized project rows joined to principal investigator (people) and (optionally) lead institution info where available. One row per project including principal_investigator id and institution-related identifiers to support queries that need person or institution context alongside project durations.

projects_with_topics.name: projects_with_topics
projects_with_topics.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project,
  pt.topic AS topic,
  p.title AS title
FROM
  projects_row_level p
JOIN
  project_topics pt
  ON pt.project = p.unics_id
projects_with_topics.description: Denormalized relation linking projects to their topics and exposing project and topic attributes for filtering and aggregation across projects by topic.

topic_title_search_cohort.name: topic_title_search_cohort
topic_title_search_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,
  t.title AS title
FROM topics t
WHERE
  -- liftable literal: minimum title length for searchability
  length(t.title) >= 4
  -- exclude purely numeric or empty titles
  AND t.title ~ '\S'
  AND t.title !~ '^\s*\d+\s*$'
ORDER BY t.code
topic_title_search_cohort.description: Subset/cohort of topics suitable for text-based title searches; exposes topic id and title for filtering and retrieval.

projects_by_principal_investigator.name: projects_by_principal_investigator
projects_by_principal_investigator.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.principal_investigator,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year
FROM projects_core p
projects_by_principal_investigator.description: Row-level cohort of projects exposing project id and the principal investigator foreign key along with core project identifiers useful for filtering and aggregation.

projects_with_pi_demographics.name: projects_with_pi_demographics
projects_with_pi_demographics.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
projects_with_pi_demographics.description: Denormalized join of projects to the people table on principal_investigator = people.unics_id to expose project rows with the PI's name for easy cohort filtering by person name.
validated_on: Show me the all different names of people

project_member_people.name: project_member_people
project_member_people.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(pmp.unics_id, pm.unics_id) AS unics_id,
  COALESCE(pmp.project, pm.project) AS project,
  COALESCE(pmp.member_name, pm.member_name) AS member_name,
  COALESCE(pmp.institution_id, pm.institution_id) AS institution_id,
  COALESCE(pmp.latitude, pm.latitude) AS latitude,
  COALESCE(pmp.longitude, pm.longitude) AS longitude,
  COALESCE(pmp.member_short_name, pm.member_short_name) AS member_short_name
FROM
  -- Prefer a join through the people table when possible (category: JOIN)
  (
    SELECT
      pe.unics_id,
      pm_inner.project,
      pm_inner.member_name,
      pm_inner.institution_id,
      pm_inner.latitude,
      pm_inner.longitude,
      pm_inner.member_short_name
    FROM project_members pm_inner
    JOIN people pe
      ON pm_inner.unics_id = pe.unics_id
  ) pmp
FULL JOIN
  -- Include all remaining project_members so every member (grain unics_id) appears
  (
    SELECT
      unics_id,
      project,
      member_name,
      institution_id,
      latitude,
      longitude,
      member_short_name
    FROM project_members
  ) pm
ON pmp.unics_id = pm.unics_id
project_member_people.description: Map project_members records to people table where possible, exposing member-level person id, member name, project id, institution id and geolocation columns for cohort filtering.

projects_with_program_and_dates.name: projects_with_program_and_dates
projects_with_program_and_dates.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.acronym AS acronym,
  p.title AS title,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.end_year AS end_year,
  p.framework_program AS framework_program,
  prog.code AS programme_code,
  prog.title AS programme_title
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN programmes prog ON prog.code = pp.programme
projects_with_program_and_dates.description: Denormalized project-level view joining projects to programme code/name (programme lookup is in programmes table). Exposes identifiers and temporal/program attributes commonly used for filtering and grouping.

projects_with_program_and_principal.name: projects_with_program_and_principal
projects_with_program_and_principal.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  -- prefer total_cost from projects table; lift literal so view consumers can override if needed
  p.total_cost,
  p.framework_program,
  pp.programme AS programme_code,
  prg.title AS programme_title,
  p.principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS pi_full_name
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN programmes prg
  ON prg.code = pp.programme
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON pe.unics_id = p.principal_investigator
projects_with_program_and_principal.description: Denormalized project-level view joining projects to programmes and principal investigator id (people) to provide project metadata for richer filtering and reporting.

project_membership_summary.name: project_membership_summary
project_membership_summary.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count,
  SUM(pm.ec_contribution) AS sum_ec_contribution
FROM
  project_members pm
GROUP BY
  pm.project
project_membership_summary.description: Aggregate measures about members per project: counts of members and sum of EC contribution, useful for filtering or ranking projects by participation or funded contribution.

project_costs_cohort.name: project_costs_cohort
project_costs_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  pf.total_cost,
  pf.ec_max_contribution
FROM
  -- base projects info (use projects_row_level when available for canonical project fields)
  projects_row_level p
LEFT JOIN
  -- financial aggregates per project (use when available to ensure consistent money fields)
  project_financials_by_project pf
ON p.unics_id = pf.unics_id
project_costs_cohort.description: Cohort of projects with their cost measures; intended for filtering by cost thresholds or computing aggregates per project.

projects_with_participants_join.name: projects_with_participants_join
projects_with_participants_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.title AS project_title,
  pm.unics_id AS member_unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  COALESCE(pf.total_cost, p.total_cost) AS total_cost
FROM
  projects_row_level p
JOIN
  project_members_by_project pm
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN
  project_financials_by_project pf
  ON pf.unics_id = p.unics_id
projects_with_participants_join.description: Denormalized view joining projects to their project_members rows and institution reference to enable filters by participant attributes alongside project attributes.

project_member_joined_project.name: project_member_joined_project
project_member_joined_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.title AS project_title,
  pm.unics_id AS member_unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role
FROM project_members pm
LEFT JOIN projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_member_joined_project.description: Denormalized view joining project members to their project rows, exposing project title alongside member attributes to support queries that need project+member data together.

erc_research_domains_base.name: erc_research_domains_base
erc_research_domains_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  trim(code) AS code,
  nullif(trim(description), '') AS description
FROM
  erc_research_domains
erc_research_domains_base.description: Canonical projection of ERC research domains exposing code and description (one row per research domain). Normalize text trimming and preserve original keys for joins.

institutions_with_country_id.name: institutions_with_country_id
institutions_with_country_id.body_sql:
SELECT
  ic.unics_id,
  ic.institutions_name,
  ic.country_id,
  ic.acronym,
  ic.short_name,
  ic.geocode_regions_3
FROM
  institutions_core ic
WHERE
  ic.country_id IS NOT NULL
institutions_with_country_id.description: One row per institution including its country_id and identifying fields; filter to institutions that have a non-NULL country_id. Useful as a base cohort for joins to country metadata or for institution-level reporting.

institution_with_country_name.name: institution_with_country_name
institution_with_country_name.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.country_id,
  c.country_name
FROM
  institutions AS i
JOIN
  countries AS c
    ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institution_with_country_name.description: Denormalized institution-level view joined to country name. One row per institution that has a matching countries.unics_id. Exposes institution identifiers and the joined country_name to answer institution-country lookup queries directly.

institutions_with_country_67.name: institutions_with_country_67
institutions_with_country_67.body_sql:
SELECT
  institutions.unics_id AS "institutions.unics_id",
  institutions.institutions_name AS "institutions.institutions_name",
  institutions.country_id AS "institutions.country_id",
  countries.unics_id AS "countries.unics_id AS country_unics_id",
  countries.country_name AS "countries.country_name"
FROM institutions
LEFT JOIN countries
  ON institutions.country_id = countries.unics_id
institutions_with_country_67.description: Denormalized view: one row per institution joined (left) to its country. Exposes institution identifiers and the joined country's identifiers and name. Uses LEFT JOIN so institutions with NULL country_id are still present.

institutions_with_country_codes.name: institutions_with_country_codes
institutions_with_country_codes.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  c.country_code2,
  c.country_code3
FROM institutions_core i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_with_country_codes.description: Institution rows joined to their country canonical codes (2- and 3-letter). One row per institution, exposing institution id and its country's codes for filtering or aggregation by country.

programme_title_by_shortname_cohort.name: programme_title_by_shortname_cohort
programme_title_by_shortname_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  code,
  short_name,
  title
FROM programmes
programme_title_by_shortname_cohort.description: A simple selectable cohort of programmes exposing short_name -> title mapping. Useful for lookups where callers filter by short_name or partial matches to find the full programme title.

project_members_core.name: project_members_core
project_members_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.member_short_name AS member_short_name,
  pm.organization_geocode_regions_3 AS organization_geocode_regions_3,
  inst.institutions_name AS institution_name,
  inst.country_id AS institution_country_id,
  inst.geocode_regions_3 AS institution_geocode_regions_3,
  inst.acronym AS institution_acronym,
  inst.short_name AS institution_short_name,
  inst.website AS institution_website,
  inst.grid_id AS institution_grid_id
FROM project_members_by_project pm
LEFT JOIN institutions_core inst
  ON pm.institution_id = inst.unics_id
project_members_core.description: Row-level canonical project members cohort exposing membership identifiers, names, role codes, institution and geo info. One row per project member (no aggregation). Useful as the base cohort for filtering by project, member, country, institution, or role.

projects_key.name: projects_key
projects_key.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym
FROM projects_core p
projects_key.description: Row-level projects table exposing primary identifiers and common dimensions used for filters/joining (acronym, unics_id, title, start_year, end_year, ec_fund_scheme, framework_program). One row per project.

project_members_with_project.name: project_members_with_project
project_members_with_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.acronym AS project_acronym
FROM
  project_members pm
LEFT JOIN
  projects p
ON
  pm.project = p.unics_id
project_members_with_project.description: Denormalized rows combining project_members with the linked project identifiers (project acronym and projects.unics_id) to simplify queries that need members of specific projects. One row per project_members.unics_id (member) with project fields copied in for filtering.
